rule.statement: The absolute owner of a vehicle has a right to claim and be heard at a claim inquiry, but does not have the right to possession as of right, and the court's discretion and findings are required.
rule.supporting_quote: Under a hire-purchase or lease agreement the absolute owner delivers the possession of the vehicle to the registered owner but retains the ownership and has a proprietary interest in the vehicle. It has a legitimate claim to it. Section 433A of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act recognizes this fact.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 433A of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act
